title: Centre-pivot vegetation change in Tabarjal, Al-Jawf: March 2019 to March 2026

headline.label: net loss of active vegetation between 2019 and 2026

data: Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance, 10 m, tile 37RDP: scene S2A_37RDP_20190306_0_L2A (6 March 2019, processing baseline 02.11, tile cloud 0.08%) and scene S2B_37RDP_20260304_0_L2A (4 March 2026, processing baseline 05.12, tile cloud 0.005%).
method: Searched Earth Search for scenes with tile cloud cover below 5% in the same season (10 February to 20 March) of 2019 and 2026, and picked 6 March 2019 and 4 March 2026, both on relative orbit 35.
Read only the 15 × 15 km window (EPSG:32637, x 430000 to 445000, y 3320000 to 3335000) of the red band B04, the near-infrared band B08 and the scene classification layer SCL.
Reflectance offset: the 2019 scene (baseline 02.11) has none.
Masked SCL classes no data, defective, cloud shadow, cloud and cirrus (0.001% of the window in 2019, 0% in 2026).
limits: NDVI is an indirect measure, not a field measurement, and no reference data was available, so no error matrix was computed and the result is exploratory. One scene per year captures the crop state on that day: a field that is harvested or fallow on 4 March 2026 counts as loss even if it is still farmed, so the figures do not measure abandoned land, yield or water use. Pixel size is 10 m, and 4% of the loss area and 5% of the gain area lie in strips narrower than 30 m along field edges, where co-registration between the scenes (about one pixel) matters.
